description:
The K10 Foldable Electric Scooter with Seat is built for adults who want a faster, smoother, and more comfortable way to commute, shop, and travel around the city. With up to 25 MPH speed, a long-range 48V 13Ah removable battery, large 14-inch pneumatic tires, dual suspension, and a comfortable padded seat, it turns everyday transportation into an easier ride.
Designed for real-life use, this scooter features a rear basket for groceries or daily essentials, front and rear lighting for visibility, dual disc brakes for reliable stopping power, and a foldable frame for convenient storage at home, work, or in your car trunk.
Whether you're heading to work, running errands, or cruising through the neighborhood, this seated electric scooter gives you the comfort, range, and stability you need to keep moving.
Key FeaturesUp to 25 MPH SpeedCruise confidently through city streets, neighborhoods, and daily routes.
48V 13Ah Long-Range BatteryRide up to 25 miles per charge with a removable battery design for easier charging.
Comfortable Seated RideAdjustable padded seat and wide non-slip deck allow relaxed riding for longer trips.
14" Pneumatic TiresLarger air-filled tires deliver better comfort, traction, and stability than small-wheel scooters.
Dual Suspension SystemHelps absorb bumps and rough pavement for a smoother ride.
Dual Disc BrakesResponsive braking system for better control and stopping confidence.
Built-In LightingFront LED headlight and rear brake light help improve visibility.
Foldable FrameFolds quickly for storage in apartments, offices, garages, or car trunks.
Rear Basket IncludedConvenient for groceries, bags, backpacks, and everyday essentials.
